findings.problem: The subject promises a build time: "built in 24 hours". brand/offers.md says never to promise a delivery date or a number of days, and the voice guide asks us to be honest.
findings.fix: Take the time promise out of the subject, e.g. "Your AI agent, at a fixed price".

findings.problem: The preview promises the agent will be "live within 24 hours". That is a delivery-time promise we must not make.
findings.fix: Change the preview to something like "One fixed price in writing before any work starts. No surprises."

findings.problem: The body says "have it live within 24 hours". That is another delivery-time promise.
findings.fix: Remove the 24-hour promise and say "the timeline is agreed in writing before work starts."

findings.problem: The email has a second main link ("See the demos" to /demos) as well as the /book link. The email rules allow exactly one main link.
findings.fix: Keep one link. Either delete the demos line and link (lines 12 and 14), or drop the /book link and make /demos the only link.

findings.problem: "This is your last chance to book a build slot with me this year" is false urgency. It sounds like a sales pitch, which goes against the voice guide's Trusted and Honest values, and nothing in the brand files supports a slot limit.
findings.fix: Remove the line, or replace it with a plain opener about what the agent can do for their business.

findings.problem: The button says "free 30-minute call", but nothing in the brand files says the first call is free or 30 minutes long. The only 30-minute call mentioned is a training call in one package, so this may stretch the truth.
findings.fix: Use plain button text like "Book a call" unless Mubashir confirms the call really is free and 30 minutes.
